table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ConsolidatedSaleOrder=H.ConsolidatedSaleOrder, 
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	QuotationDate=H.Date, 
	QuotationCode=H.QuotationCode, 
	CustCode=H.CustCode, 
	CustAlias = A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	Qty = D.Qty, 
	BonusQty = D.BonusQty
FROM
	QuotationHeader H, QuotationDetail D, Item I, Accounts A
WHERE
	H.ConsolidatedSaleOrder = :ai_consolidated_saleorder AND
	H.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	D.ICode = :ai_icode AND
	H.QuotationCode = D.QuotationCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY
	Customer
